Callout.Name: Weapon at the Hospital
Callout.Message: Person in an emergency department with a weapon.
Callout.Advisory: Staff withdrawn, patients still on the floor.

Script.Line: I am not putting it down until somebody tells me what is happening to my wife.
Nobody has spoken to me in four hours. Nobody.
I am not going to hurt anybody. I want somebody to talk to me.

Lines.Approach: The staff have pulled back and the patients are still in there. Nobody is going to complain if this is quick.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
